description: Congresswoman Lori Trahan has been at the forefront of a bipartisan effort to save Minor League Baseball teams across this country, including the Lowell Spinners right here in the Third District. title: Representative Lori Trahan Congresswoman Lori Trahan was born and raised in a working-class family in Lowell, Massachusetts. She is the mom of two young girls and proudly represents Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District.
